The vendor directly providing **Cvent** at **cvent.com** is **Cvent, Inc.**

### Supporting Evidence
According to the official **Cvent Website Terms of Use** at `cvent.com`:
> *"These Website Terms of Use ("Terms") govern your use of the website that links to these Terms (the “Website”) and are a legally binding agreement between you ("User" or "you") and Cvent, Inc., including its subsidiaries and affiliates (collectively, "CVENT", "we," "us", or "our")."*

This is additionally corroborated by the **Cvent Community Terms of Use**, which confirms:
> *"This Agreement is between you (“You” or “Your”) and Cvent, Inc. on behalf of itself and its wholly-owned subsidiaries, as applicable (“Cvent” or “We” or “Our”)."*

The company also assists hoteliers in boosting group business demand through targeted advertising and advanced analytics. Cvent's integrated platform optimizes the event management process and supports the organization of hundreds of thousands of events annually.
